```python
def on_btn_filter(self, *args) -> None:
    search = self.ports.search.get()
    if not search:
        self.ports.fruits.set(self.ports.fruits.items())
        self.ports.count.set(f"{len(self.ports.fruits.items())} items")
        self.ports.filter.enable(False)
        return
    original_items = self.ports.fruits.items()
    filtered_items = [item for item in original_items if search.lower() in item.lower()]
    self.ports.fruits.set(filtered_items)
    self.ports.count.set(f"{len(filtered_items)} items")
    self.ports.filter.enable(True)
```

```python
def on_btn_filter(self, *args) -> None:
    search_text = self.ports.search.get().strip().lower()
    original_fruits = getattr(self, "_ai_original_fruits", None)
    
    if original_fruits is None:
        original_fruits = self.ports.fruits.items()
        self._ai_original_fruits = original_fruits
    
    if not search_text:
        filtered_fruits = original_fruits
    else:
        filtered_fruits = [fruit for fruit in original_fruits if search_text in fruit.lower()]
    
    self.ports.fruits.set(filtered_fruits)
    self.ports.count.set(f"{len(filtered_fruits)} items")
```
